derivedFrom: 22.10's walk worked by hand over a constructed tape, not a run. Four members over six sessions, the first and the fourth each month's first: A closing at 100 and rising 2 a session, B at 50 falling 1, C at 20 rising 1 and D flat at 10. At the first reshuffle A scores 8 of 9, B 7 of 9, C 6 of 9 and D 9 of 9 dearer than its median; at the second B falls to 6 of 9 and C rises to 7. A book of two at the starting floor and valuation holds A and B from the first; at the second B is sold at its close of 47, 47 / 50 - 1 = -6 per cent, against the four members answered on its night from the first session to the fourth, A 6, B -6, C 15 and D 0 per cent, a mean of 3.75, an edge of -9.75 points; the tester's month from the first reshuffle to the second reads A's 6 less 3.75 and B's -6 less 3.75, a mean of -3.75 points. Sold on a filing, A's first session after a filing reading 5 of 9 sells it at that close of 102, 2 per cent, against the members' 2, -2, 5 and 0 per cent from its night, 1.25.
